entry.title: From a forgotten TV box to a retro console
entry.summary: An old Nexbox A95X-B7N, a 32 GB microSD and EmuELEC 4.8: from flashing and a toothpick in the AV jack to 758 damaged files, CHD, BIOS, box art, settings and an arcade theme. (Also in Macedonian: https://kocev.mk/blog/tv-box-to-retro-console/?lang=mk)
